name: sentry
description: Audit, initialize and harden Sentry in any repo, CLI-first on the sentry v4 CLI. Detects what the repo is, finds gaps or sets Sentry up properly, applies only what you approve, and proves it with a live event.

hook_mode.title: Hook mode
hook_mode.description: on: all hooks active. quiet: hooks only block (token paste, unapproved Sentry writes, premature stop) and add no advisory context. off: no hooks.
